# IMD 0.25° gridded daily rainfall (not included in this repository)

The 76 yearly NetCDF files (ind1950_rfp25.nc to ind2025_rfp25.nc, about 1.8 GB in total) are too large for GitHub, so they are not stored here. They are free to download from the India Meteorological Department, Pune:

- Download page: https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/Rainfall_25_NetCDF.html
- Direct form endpoint used by the project: https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/RF25.php (POST field `RF25=<year>`)
- Reference: D. S. Pai et al., Mausam, vol. 65, no. 1, pp. 1–18, 2014.

To download all years into this folder automatically, run from `05 Code`:

```
python src/download_large_raw.py
```

Place the files in this folder (`data/raw/rainfall/imd_gridded_0p25_netcdf/`). The SHA-256 checksums below confirm that a downloaded file is the same one the project used.
